## Extraction of markers from the most common haplotypes
According to the tree in 2024-01-19 for COI and the 
haplotype network in 2024-01-17. 
```{bash, collapse = TRUE}
if [ ! -d SampITS2_farionis ]; then mkdir SampITS2_farionis; fi
for i in $(cat ../2024-01-19/farionis.txt); do
  if [ ! -e SampITS2_farionis/${i}_ITS2.fa ]; then
    BAM=../2023-10-02/BAM_ITS2_MT_Cpse/${i}.bam
    samtools consensus -r ITS2_MT_Cpse $BAM -A --P-het 0 \
                         -l 2000 -a --show-del yes --show-ins no | \
    sed "s/>ITS2_MT_Cpse/>${i}/" >> SampITS2_farionis/${i}_ITS2.fa
  fi
done
if [ ! -e farSamp.fa ]; then cat SampITS2_farionis/*.fa > farSamp.fa; fi

if [ ! -d SampITS2_pseudo ]; then mkdir SampITS2_pseudo; fi
for i in $(cat ../2024-01-19/pseudo.txt); do
  if [ ! -e SampITS2_pseudo/${i}_ITS2.fa ]; then
    BAM=../2023-10-02/BAM_ITS2_MT_Cpse/${i}.bam
    samtools consensus -r ITS2_MT_Cpse $BAM -A --P-het 0 \
                         -l 2000 -a --show-del yes --show-ins no | \
    sed "s/>ITS2_MT_Cpse/>${i}/" >> SampITS2_pseudo/${i}_ITS2.fa
  fi
done
if [ ! -e pseSamp.fa ]; then cat SampITS2_pseudo/*.fa > pseSamp.fa; fi
```

```{r}
suppressWarnings(library(Biostrings))
```

## Obtain the sequences of ITS2 for Crepidostomum from GeneBank 
```{bash, collapse=TRUE}
# From ENA:
if [ ! -d Genbank ]; then mkdir Genbank; fi
if [ ! -e Genbank/CrepiITS2ENA.fa ]; then
   if [ ! -e Genbank/INFO_accessionsITS.txt ]; then
   ## ITS2
      PORTAL="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/search?"
      RESULT="result=sequence&"
      QUERY="query=tax_tree(334452)%20AND%20description%3D%22internal%20transcribed%20spacer%202%2C%20complete%22&"
      FIELDS="fields=accession%2Cscientific_name%2Chost%2Ccountry%2Ctax_id&"
      FORMAT="format=tsv"
      curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT >> Genbank/INFO_accessionsITS.txt
      # if I do Coi and Cox1 at the same time add this | tail -n +2 
      #curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT | tail -n +2 >> Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt
   fi
   BROWSER="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/fasta/"
   cut -f 1 Genbank/INFO_accessionsITS.txt | tail -n +2 > Genbank/accessionsITS.txt
   ACCESSIONS=$(gawk -v ORS="," '{print}' Genbank/accessionsITS.txt |  sed 's/.$//' )
   curl -s $BROWSER$ACCESSIONS > Genbank/CrepiITS2ENA.fa
fi

# From NCBI: the sequences in the description study of C. pse 
# are missing, so we download it manually from Genbank. 
# Folder ../2024-01-17/Genbank
```

## Edit and selecting the sequences of GenBank
FROM ENA: DONE before
From NCBI: the sequences in the description study of C. pse 
are missing, so we download it manually from Genbank. 

All in folder ../2024-01-17/Genbank
```{r, collapse = TRUE, warning=FALSE}
suppressWarnings(library('DECIPHER'))
suppressWarnings(library('htmltools'))
suppressWarnings(library('stringr'))

## Edit the sequences of GenBank
CrepiITS2ENA <- c(readDNAStringSet("../2024-01-17/Genbank/Cfarionis_ITS2.fasta"),
                  readDNAStringSet("../2024-01-17/Genbank/Cpseudofarionis_ITS.fasta"))
CrepiITS2ENA2 <- readDNAStringSet("../2024-01-17/Genbank/CrepiITS2ENA.fa")
## Adding the information 
if (!file.exists("Crepi_ITS2_GB_ENA.fa")) {
  info <- read.delim("../2024-01-17/Genbank/INFO_accessionsITS.txt", header = TRUE)
  rownames(info) <- info$accession
  for (i in 1:length(names(CrepiITS2ENA2))) {
    name <- paste0("C.", strsplit(names(CrepiITS2ENA2), " ")[[i]][3])
    accession <- strsplit(names(CrepiITS2ENA2), "\\|")[[i]][2]
    #host <- paste0(strsplit(info[accession, 3], " ")[[1]][1], "_", strsplit(info[accession, 3], " ")[[1]][2])
    country <- str_to_upper(substr(info[accession, 4], 1,2))
    names(CrepiITS2ENA2)[i] <- paste0(accession, "_", name, "_", country)
  }
  
  for (i in 1:length(names(CrepiITS2ENA))) {
    name <- paste0("C.", strsplit(names(CrepiITS2ENA), " ")[[i]][3])
    accession <- strsplit(strsplit(names(CrepiITS2ENA), " ")[[i]][1], "\\.1")[1]
    #host <- paste0(strsplit(info[accession, 3], " ")[[1]][1], "_", strsplit(info[accession, 3], " ")[[1]][2])
    country <- "IC/RU"
    names(CrepiITS2ENA)[i] <- paste0(accession, "_", name, "_", country)
  }
  
  CrepiITS2 <- c(CrepiITS2ENA2[names(CrepiITS2ENA2)[-grep(".sp.", names(CrepiITS2ENA2), fixed = TRUE)]], CrepiITS2ENA)
  writeXStringSet(CrepiITS2, "Crepi_ITS2_GB_ENA.fa")
}

CrepiITS2 <- readDNAStringSet("Crepi_ITS2_GB_ENA.fa")

names(CrepiITS2)[(grep(".farionis", names(CrepiITS2), fixed = TRUE))]
CrepiITS2 <- CrepiITS2[-grep(".farionis", names(CrepiITS2), fixed = TRUE)[c(2:10)]]

names(CrepiITS2)[(grep("pseudofarionis", names(CrepiITS2), fixed = TRUE))]
CrepiITS2 <- CrepiITS2[-grep("pseudofarionis", names(CrepiITS2), fixed = TRUE)[c(2:5)]]

names(CrepiITS2)[(grep("illinoiense", names(CrepiITS2), fixed = TRUE))]
CrepiITS2 <- CrepiITS2[-grep("illinoiense", names(CrepiITS2), fixed = TRUE)[c(1:5)]]

names(CrepiITS2)[(grep("affine", names(CrepiITS2), fixed = TRUE))]
CrepiITS2 <- CrepiITS2[-grep("affine", names(CrepiITS2), fixed = TRUE)[c(2:3)]]

names(CrepiITS2)[(grep("oschmarini", names(CrepiITS2), fixed = TRUE))]
CrepiITS2 <- CrepiITS2[-grep("oschmarini", names(CrepiITS2), fixed = TRUE)[c(2:6)]]

writeXStringSet(CrepiITS2, "Crepi_ITS2_GB_ENA_2.fa")
```



## Obtain the two outgroups for the phylogeny 
```{bash, collapse=TRUE}
## Allocreadium gotoi
if [ ! -e accessionAN.txt ]; then
   PORTAL="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/search?"
   RESULT="result=sequence&"
   QUERY="query=accession=MH143077&"
   FIELDS="fields=accession%2Cscientific_name&"
   FORMAT="format=tsv"
   curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT | \
   cut -f 1 | tail -n +2 > accessionAN.txt
fi
BROWSER="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/fasta/"
ACCESSION=$(gawk -v ORS="," '{print}' accessionAN.txt | sed 's/.$//' | cut -d ',' -f 1)
if [ ! -e $ACCESSION.fa ]; then 
  curl -s $BROWSER$ACCESSION > $ACCESSION.fa
  sed -i "/>/c >${ACCESSION}_Allocreadium_neotenicum_NO" ${ACCESSION}.fa
fi
cat ${ACCESSION}.fa >> Outgroups.fa

## Allocreadium khankaiensis
if [ ! -e accessionAI.txt ]; then
   PORTAL="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/search?"
   RESULT="result=sequence&"
   QUERY="query=accession=MH143096&"
   FIELDS="fields=accession%2Cscientific_name&"
   FORMAT="format=tsv"
   curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT | \
   cut -f 1 | tail -n +2 > accessionAI.txt
fi
BROWSER="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/fasta/"
ACCESSION=$(gawk -v ORS="," '{print}' accessionAI.txt | sed 's/.$//' | cut -d ',' -f 1)
if [ ! -e $ACCESSION.fa ]; then 
  curl -s $BROWSER$ACCESSION > $ACCESSION.fa
  sed -i "/>/c >${ACCESSION}_Allocreadium_isoporum_IC" ${ACCESSION}.fa
fi
cat ${ACCESSION}.fa >> Outgroups.fa
rm *.txt
```


# Reconstruct the phylogeny 

First, align and visualize the sequences (with R and Mafft)

```{r, collapse=TRUE}

CrepiITS2 <- readDNAStringSet("Crepi_ITS2_GB_ENA_2.fa")
Outgroups <- readDNAStringSet("Outgroups.fa")

FAR <- readDNAStringSet("farSamp.fa")
PSE <- readDNAStringSet("pseSamp.fa")
#Cox_RefGen <- readDNAStringSet("Cox1_RefGen.fa")

Seq_tree <- c(CrepiITS2, FAR, PSE, Outgroups)
writeXStringSet(Seq_tree, "SeqITS2_tree.fa")
#BrowseSeqs(AlignSeqs(Seq_tree))
```

### Align the sequences with mafft
```{bash}
FOLDER=RAxML/round01
if [ ! -d RAxML ]; then mkdir RAxML; fi
if [ ! -d $FOLDER ]; then mkdir $FOLDER; fi
if [ ! -e $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg ]; then
  mafft --maxiterate 1000 --thread 24 --localpair SeqITS2_tree.fa > $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg
fi
```
#### Trimm the alignment
```{bash}
FOLDER=RAxML/round01
#if [ ! -e AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg-gb1 ]; then
  Gblocks $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg -t=d -b1=20 -b2=30 -e=-gb1 -d=y -v=1000 -b5=h
  #mv $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg-gb1 $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft_02.alg
#fi
```

```{r}
if (file.exists("RAxML/round01/AlignTree_Mafft.alg") == FALSE) {
  Align <- readDNAStringSet("RAxML/round01/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg-gb1")
  #BrowseSeqs(subseq(Align, start = 97, end = 241))
  #Align <- subseq(Align, start = 173, end = 320)
  writeXStringSet(Align, "RAxML/round01/AlignTree_Mafft.alg")
}
```

### Reconstruct the tree
```{bash, collapse = TRUE}
FOLDER=RAxML/round01

if [ ! -e T1_1000.raxml.support ]; then 
  raxml-ng --all --msa $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg --model GTR+G --prefix $FOLDER/T1_1000 --bs-trees 1000 --threads 48
fi
if [ ! -e $FOLDER/EvalMod_GTR+R4.raxml.log ]; then 
  for i in GTR+G GTR+R4 GTR JC JC+G; do
    raxml-ng --evaluate --msa $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg --tree $FOLDER/T1_1000.raxml.bestTree --model ${i} --prefix $FOLDER/EvalMod_${i}
  done
fi
```

```{bash}
FOLDER=RAxML/round01
# Which model yields the highest log-likelihood? 
grep "logLikelihood" $FOLDER/EvalMod*
## The model is GTR+R4, but
# AIC/BIC scores (lower values are better)
grep "AIC" $FOLDER/EvalMod*
```

```{bash, collapse = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
FOLDER=RAxML/round01
## Finally run a tree Search
raxml-ng --msa $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg --model GTR+G --prefix $FOLDER/T2 --threads 48 --redo

## Compute and map bootstrap support values to the best ML tree (S1.raxml.bestTree)
raxml-ng --bootstrap --msa $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg --model GTR+G --prefix $FOLDER/S2_bestTree --tree $FOLDER/T2.raxml.bestTree --threads 48 --bs-trees 10000
# Recompute support values using the Transfer Bootstrap Expectation (TBE) algorithm. Did this change the support values?
raxml-ng --support --tree $FOLDER/T2.raxml.bestTree --bs-trees $FOLDER/S2_bestTree.raxml.bootstraps --prefix $FOLDER/S2_FBP --threads 48 --bs-metric fbp
#raxml-ng --support --tree $FOLDER/T2.raxml.bestTree --bs-trees $FOLDER/S2_bestTree.raxml.bootstraps --prefix $FOLDER/S2_TBE --threads 48 --bs-metric tbe

```
